en: "Y-you got my old man's blueprints? ...Not yet, huh.{w}Aw, man, you got my hopes up for nothin'. Next time, come back once you've found 'em!!"{w}
You showed "Old Man's Plans" to Fulgrant.{w}
note: Item name as in pilot row 8; quotes kept from the source brackets.

en: "Wh... Whoa!!! This is..."{w}{p}"It's my old man's blueprints, the ones I lost! No doubt about it!!{w}You really went and found 'em for me..."{w}

"Amazin'... You actually found 'em!!{w}Right, with these, that cannon's gettin' finished for sure! ...So, uh, about that..."{w}{p}"To build a cannon, see... you need tools. You get that, right?{w}Well, I went and lost the cannon tools too."{w}{p}"I can't build it like this! You lot... go find me those tools!!"{w}{p}"It's all so we can get at the Palace of the Sun. If you could find the blueprints, the tools'll be a snap for you, right? I'm countin' on you!"{w}
"Haah, them cannon tools just ain't turnin' up anywhere...{w}What, you lot ain't found 'em yet either?"{w}{p}"We'll keep lookin' too, but you lot keep at it as well!!"{w}
You showed "Cannon Tools" to Fulgrant.{w}
"Wha... Is that...!?{w}Those are the cannon tools, ain't they!!! You did it, you lot! Knew you had it in ya..."{w}{p}"Now we can build the cannon! Just you wait, my dear Kin of Darkness..."{w}
note: 'kin of darkness' = [JP] as in wmap slice_20; the honorific [JP] is mock-polite, rendered 'my dear'.

en: "...So, anyway. I've been thinkin'.{w}Once the cannon's done, we fire it into the Palace of the Sun -- 'KA-BOOOOM!' -- right?"{w}{p}"And when that happens, just standin' around watchin' would be pretty boring, don'tcha think?"{w}
note: 'KA-BOOOOM!' for the quoted [JP]; same rendering in row 1197. Row 1175 (slice_014) has the same sound and should match.

en: "Course you do! So what we're plannin' is, when we shoot down the Palace of the Sun, we all go 'WOOOOO!' and party it up!!"{w}{p}"And for that, we need bar snacks, right!{w}The plan is, everybody munches away while we whoop it up! And of course, the more folks watchin', the better!"{w}{p}"We'll invite a whole crowd... and then, if we watch it while munchin' on Seasoned Snacks..."{w}{p}"It's gonna be a blast, no question! You lot wanna eat some too, right?"{w}{p}"...Right, it's settled! We need Seasoned Snacks. I'm countin' on you! Go find some!"{w}
note: Item name 'Seasoned Bar Snacks' (pilot row 10) used as the noun, since the scene is the hunt for that key item.

en: "So, find any Seasoned Snacks?{w}Hurry up and find 'em!! You wanna see the Palace of the Sun come down soon, don'tcha?"{w}

"Listen up, boys! It won't be long now...!
Let's show 'em what we're made of!!"{w}
note: [JP] = Fulgrant rallying his own ogre/goblin crew (not the party); 'boys' keeps the rough masculine [JP].

en: "...Oh? It's you lot."{w}
You showed "Seasoned Snacks" to Fulgrant.{w}

"Yeah, this is it...!!
Seasoned Snacks, the real deal!!!{w}You did great findin' 'em!!"{w}
"Alllright, we'll get right to work on the preparations!{w}Once you lot are ready too, come talk to me! It won't be long now!!"{w}

"Yo, here's where we're at over here.
You lot ready?"{w}
"What, you ain't ready yet...?"{w}{p}"Well, there's still time. Get yourselves good and ready, then come talk to me again!"{w}

"We're all set over here.
Well then, let's go fire this thing!"{w}

"Right! Let's get straight to it... You lot!!!
Here we go -- 'KA-BOOOOM!'!!!"{w}
note: [JP]: could be his crew or the party; kept as an ambiguous 'You lot'.

en: "...Let 'er riiiiiiiip!!!"{w}
"Huh, that's weird...{w}Nothin's broken anywhere, right!?"{w}
note: Identical source to row 1202; same English. Cannon misfire branch (1200-1201).

en: "That's 'cause you handle it so rough, Lord Fulgrant~"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Lord Fulgrant' (cf. [JP] = 'Lord Void' in wmap slice_20).

en: "Sorry 'bout this. Looks like the repairs are gonna take a while..."{w}
"Huh, that's weird...{w}Nothin's broken anywhere, right!?"{w}
note: Source has a stray full-width space before the final {w}; dropped. Same English as row 1199.

en: As if answering Fulgrant's voice, the ogres and goblins living in Ogre Bay gathered in one spot in no time at all.{w}
Goblin A
"Oh, so you came too, huh!"{w}
Goblin B
Ogre A

"Well? Ain't it a beauty?
I built that bit over there, y'know."{w}
Ogre B

"Like hell you did.
I built that!"{w}
note: [JP] ('don't talk rubbish') rendered as a colloquial contradiction.

en: Goblin C

"Oho, goin' at it, huh.
Bein' lively's fine, but keep that up and you'll miss the big moment when the cannon fires, y'know?"{w}

"Guess you got a point...
H-hey! It's about to start!"{w}
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!{w}A thunderous roar rang out all around, shaking the air.{w}
note: [JP] SFX; same rendering in row 1230.

en: The cannon scored a direct hit on the Palace of the Sun!{w}...It did, but the palace didn't budge an inch.{w}{p}Nothing had changed at all between before the cannon fired and now.{w}
"Wh... What!?{w}It didn't do a thing...?"{w}
After thinking for a moment, Fulgrant stares hard at you, as if struck by an idea.{w}You get a bad feeling about this.{w}

Before you knew it, Fulgrant had grabbed you and forcibly crammed you into the cannon.
From inside the cannon, you could see the sky.{w}
All Goblins
"Threee!!"{w}
All Ogres
"Twooo!!"{w}
Everyone
"Ooone!!"{w}
"Fiiire~~!!"{w}
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!{w}

"How was it, you lot?
How'd it feel bein' a cannonball?"{w}

"You lot did good.
See? You made it back just fine, didn't ya!!"{w}{p}"Look, everybody's gathered here to catch a glimpse of you lot, y'know?"{w}
note: First page identical to row 1243.

en: Everyone appeared in the hall, and you received their praise.{w}

"So I hear you got shot all the way to the Palace of the Sun with that cannon?{w}That must've been rough, huh?"{w}{p}"Still, you did great!
Congratulations!"{w}

"Lord Fulgrant's cannon truly is in a league of its own, isn't it.{w}To think it reached all the way to the Palace of the Sun..."{w}{p}"Thank you for all your hard work.
And congratulations."{w}
note: Mayleen's polite [JP] register kept refined.

en: "Here's your reward. Take it."{w}
note: Source opens with a full-width indent space; dropped.
Second-page [JP] is most likely his crew; left as an ambiguous 'you lot'.

en: "You lot..........{w}...who were you again?"{w}
"Hey, Balgert was lookin' for you lot, y'know."{w}
"Hey, Rianna was lookin' for you lot, y'know."{w}
"Hey, that brat from Perpeco was lookin' for you lot, y'know."{w}
note: [JP]: a child from Perpeco (place in glossary); identity not settled here, kept gender-neutral.

en:
"We let the ogres handle the heavy lifting,{w}'cause for us goblins,
usin' our brains is what it's all about."{w}

"...Well, this is a fine mess.
What am I supposed to do?"{w}{p}"Oh, perfect timin'. Hear me out a sec.{w}Ogre Bay's filthy, so I've been told to give the place a big cleanup, but..."{w}{p}"See 'em? Those black lumps, all piled up over by the edge there?{w}Those're all... Ultimate... y'know..."{w}{p}"...Sorry to ask, but you lot are adventurers, right?{w}I'll get the rest cleaned up quick, so could you clean those up for me?"{w}{p}"Hey, we all gotta help each other out when times are tough. Please? C'mon.{w}At this rate, Ogre Bay's gonna be ruined..."{w}
note: [JP] = the Ultimate Runner monsters (MONSTER1.CSV); the ogre trails off rather than say the full name, as in EVENT_TEXT 59:8. 'black lumps' = [JP] (also SCD09:30002 rows 1166-1168). Last page = row 1250.

en: "Hey, we all gotta help each other out when times are tough. Please? C'mon.{w}At this rate, Ogre Bay's gonna be ruined..."{w}
note: Identical to the last page of row 1249.

en:
"Aah, what a nightmare that was...
Thanks for all your trouble too, you lot.{w}You really helped me out."{w}
"Even leavin' a mess uncleaned, there's a limit, y'know.{w}From now on, I gotta clean up regular-like."{w}
Dr. Mad
note: New name. [JP] romanized as a title-name; 16-char limit.

en: "Uhyahyahya! Another idea strikes!{w}The common rabble could never grasp what it's for!{w}My own skill and genius frighten me!"{w}{p}"Uhyahyahyahya!{w}Oh! Ah! What's this!? Not yet!{w}If I modify this, something even more amazing will...!!"{w}

"Uhyahyahya! Another idea strikes!{w}Eh, who are you lot? How long have you been there?{w}A contraption for catching magic puppets, you say?"{w}{p}"Uhyahyahya, I see, I see!{w}So it's you who want it! Marvelous!{w}Mmm, my own genius frightens me."{w}{p}"Nothing I make could ever be useless!{w}There's always someone out there who needs it!{w}And now that has been proven!"{w}{p}"Right then, take it! I don't need your money!{w}Someone who wants it has come! That's my reward!{w}Uhyahyahyahya!!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'magic puppet' (Decoy is one, per MON_TEXT 346); this is the trap Milonya asked for (wmap slice_15 rows 1126-1134).

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Magic Puppet Trap.{w}
note: New item name [JP]; format as wmap slice_01 key-item rows.

en: "I really am a genius after all!{w}Uhyahyahyahyahya!{w}Ooh, another idea strikes!!"{w}

"You seen that Dr. Mad?{w}The stuff the doc makes is amazin', but...{w}there's just no use for any of it..."{w}{p}"Even if it's a capture trap, at that size...{w}it's too small for a Carbuncle,{w}and too big for an Ultimate Runner..."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'the doc' to avoid assuming gender. Carbuncle / Ultimate Runner are monster names (MONSTER1.CSV), not yet in glossary.

en: Mysterious Ninja

"Did you folks sneak into this castle too?{w}I may look like this right now,{w}but believe it or not, I'm a crack intelligence agent, y'know?"{w}{p}"Infiltrate, get caught on purpose, and dig up inside information.{w}Spy work 101.{w}............Honest, okay?"{w}
note: Speaker is apparently locked up in the castle (cf. thief in 1261); [JP] read as 'look like this' to keep both costume and captivity open.

en: "Ah, hey there! Get me outta here!{w}I thought, 'Huh, what an unusual castle,' and wandered in, and next thing I know I got nabbed!"{w}{p}"I ain't even stolen anything yet!!"{w}
Sickly Fencer
note: [JP]; 'Fencer' rather than 'Swordsman' to avoid assuming gender.
